long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without asking are still bothering me, and I would like the answer in writing.

steps.makes: a drawing of the waning moon
steps.reason: The waning moon is only 22% lit and I still have not settled its colour, so I will draw it once more.
The flowers I planted are mine, so they go on record.
A finished clay bowl is worth a close look, though I will pretend I only glanced at it.
The lookout rock is mine by sitting on it, and it should be on record too.
One more page on the moon will do, since I have decided to read the answer after all.
My energy is running low and a patch of sun is the sensible place to fix that.
The drum makes a sound when hit and it is mine, so it should be kept on record.

today.reason: The seeds and the moon are still unsettled, so I will read and draw about them, photograph what is mine, and nap before the evening.
